result.headline: CPSC recalled CooCooBaby baby loungers, then warned the firm hasn't provided the agreed remedy.
result.safety_note: CPSC announced a recall of CooCooBaby baby loungers on June 18, 2026 (recall 26-569, about 2,355 units) for suffocation and fall hazards that violate the mandatory standard for infant sleep products. CPSC later issued a warning saying the firm has been uncooperative and has not provided the agreed refund, and urged consumers to dispose of the product. The loungers were sold on CooCooBabyOfficial.com and Amazon from December 2024 through March 2026.
